reason: Paying nothing upfront is fair, I'll give him that, but my last designer also promised the world and I lost months chasing him. A guy in Kuwait with no UK reviews and one anonymous project means if it drags, I'm the one wasting my evenings again.
objection: No reviews and no past clients I can actually ring. Not paying upfront protects my money, not my time, and the logins only come after I pay, so he still holds the keys.
would_change_my_mind: A written delivery date with a penalty if he misses it, plus one real UK owner I can message who says he finished on time.
